loadTestComparison.note: Burst load tests used the env API key path and short duration. Soak uses a DB-backed soak-load credential on every request.

ruledOut.rateLimiting: 0 x 429 after performance-test profile; all 36820 were 202
ruledOut.hmacReplay: HMAC SHA-256 plus Redis NX is sub-millisecond relative to 800 ms
ruledOut.queueBacklogForIngest: ingest returns 202 after enqueue; P95 is request time before worker persistence completes
ruledOut.hostSaturation: worker and API ready probes stayed true; soak client RSS 71.7 MB

primaryCause: Per-request scrypt verify plus lastUsedAt UPDATE on the same api_credential row and a CREDENTIAL_USED audit insert, plus three installation-identity lookups. Concurrent worker telemetry upserts serialize those credential-row writes. Burst load tests did not take this path.
mitigation: 15s credential cache, 60s lastUsedAt throttle, 30s installation identity cache, cache invalidation on revoke/rotate. Soak P95 budget remains 1000 ms (looser than the 500 ms burst load-test budget).

postMitigationProbe.note: Steady-state P50 dropped from 525 ms to ~16 ms, confirming credential-row lock as the soak median. Burst P95/P99 remain high under concurrency 10 immediately after a gateway restart while the worker drains a backlog. The 24h soak is steady ~8 rps, not this burst shape. Long-duration P95 must be re-measured on the restarted 24h run.
